grammar.wildcard: `*` only as a separate final token (`cmd sub *`) or as the `:*` suffix (`cmd sub:*`); a wildcard needs a literal non-option token after the program
grammar.match: no wildcard is exact, including a bare program name (accepted, and reported with a notice because it matches only that command with no arguments); `:*` or a final `*` is a prefix
grammar.option_order: options before a goal or subcommand are literal and order-sensitive (`mvn -o test:*` does not match `mvn -q -o test` or `mvn -o -q test`); a wildcard needs that goal after the options (`mvn -o test:*`, not `mvn -o:*`). A launched command with no subcommand, such as `npx tsc:*`, needs an exact command (`npx tsc --noEmit -p .`). Programs whose arguments start with options, such as xcodebuild, also need one exact full command line
grammar.program: a lowercase bare name; shells, wrappers, evaluators, system tools, docker, podman, kubectl and nix are refused
grammar.paths: tokens containing / must be plain relative paths or absolute paths that resolve inside the repository, optionally as --option=path
grammar.interpreters: python -m <module> or <interpreter> <script with a script extension>
